description: 半島循環道路データ [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in National Land Numerical Information (国土数値情報) download site of MLIT, Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 国土交通省. 我が国の「半島循環道路」・「半島振興対策実施地域の主要道路」・「半島振興対策実施地域の異常気象通行規制区間」・「半島振興対策実施地域対象市町村」からなる全国の半島循環道路の位置や概要を示す空間データです。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国土交通省. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp, geojson. The portal shows 2015-12-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is non-commercial use only under the download site terms. Caveats: this record was written from the product page on the download site (title, description where given, licence, formats and dates), so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-japan-mlit-national-land-numerical-information.
